roles.title: Junior Business Analyst – GIS
roles.description: Leads the cross-functional modernization of a mission-critical gas-electric incident notification system, from requirements through validation and delivery.
highlights: Run workshops with GIS, control-center, support, architecture and engineering leaders, map current and future states, and turn them into prioritized business rules, risks, dependencies and success criteria.
Write the BRD/FRD, process and data-flow maps, and the reporting, UAT, migration and rollout recommendations.
Build consensus on the 200-ft/24-hour proximity logic, a centralized architecture, monitoring and security, and the implementation sequence.
Drive open issues through validation to delivery.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
roles.description: Owns six strategic analytics workstreams whose findings go to Operations, Product, Finance, Sales, Support and leadership.
highlights: Workstreams: Voice of Patient, PC Performance, AI Disposition, Salesforce transfer reporting, communication hold/release, and Twilio/Calabrio reconciliation.
Run deep dives, forecasts, variance, funnel, A/B and pre/post analyses and scenario models in SQL and Python on Snowflake, Databricks and BigQuery.
Define KPIs, reconcile conflicting data sources and quantify tradeoffs, then automate the recurring decision tools in Power BI, Tableau, Sigma and Excel.
Turn the analysis into executive narratives that shape roadmap and process priorities, and support QA/UAT and training.

roles.title: Technical Intern, Continuous Improvement
roles.description: Built a fleet-planning forecasting tool and ran continuous-improvement projects across operations.
highlights: Built Fleet Forecaster with React, Flask, PostgreSQL, SQL, Python and Excel/VBA to model fleet demand, capacity, cost and budget scenarios.
Cut processing from 6 hours to 5 minutes, about $120K in annualized savings, and turned the results into planning recommendations.

Led continuous-improvement workstreams from discovery to implementation: mapped current and future processes, built business cases, and automated workflows with Power Apps, Power Automate, Python and APIs.
Used AI prototypes to remove manual steps while tracking risks and dependencies across stakeholders.

roles.title: Data Analyst – Business Intelligence & Financial Analytics
roles.description: Ran client-facing analytics and strategy engagements across sales, marketing, finance, product and operations.
highlights: Built performance and financial models covering growth drivers, profitability, ROI, forecasts and scenarios; the recommendations generated $200K+ in client value.
Integrated Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, API and cloud data, and automated the analytics with SQL, Python, dbt and Airflow.
Managed BI and data workstreams from requirements to adoption, aligning clients and technical teams on KPIs, scope, data models and delivery.
Created reusable dashboards, playbooks and decision frameworks.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst – Data & Systems Analytics
roles.description: Diagnosed clients’ business and operational problems with data and ran several delivery workstreams at once.
highlights: Analyzed customer, product, conversion, retention, churn, sales, marketing and financial performance, and presented recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Turned ambiguous requests into scoped requirements, user stories, process/data flows, tests and implementation plans.
Used advanced SQL, Python and BI tools to find root causes and quantify options, and supported UAT and training.
Standardized reusable processes that cut onboarding time by 30%.
